description: You are a Clinical Data Manager processing a complex patient transfer intake. A new patient — Amara Nwosu, female, Date of Birth: 1972-04-19, from Lagos, Nigeria (Country: NG) — has been transferred from a regional hospital with established diagnoses of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and Hypertension. You must complete her full intake in OpenClinic GA as follows: (1) Register her as a new patient with the demographic details provided; (2) Create a new clinical encounter for her; (3) Add two chronic medications she is currently taking: Metformin 500mg (1 tablet twice daily) and Amlodipine 5mg (1 tablet once daily); (4) Order two baseline laboratory tests: HbA1c and Creatinine (CREAT); (5) Schedule a follow-up appointment within the next 30 days. All five steps must be completed for full credit. Login: username '4', password 'openclinic'. URL: http://localhost:10088/openclinic.
